text:
alex.hunt: quick q — our current v2 rollout uses a hard cutover for some customers, but we'd like a soft fallback strategy where requests transparently fall back to v1 when v2 is degraded (latency or quota). how do folks feel about adding a per-customer "soft_fallback" toggle + telemetry to track fallback events?

samir.rai: +1 for the toggle. main concerns: (1) accurate telemetry so we don't miss user-visible errors, (2) quota accounting — if we fallback to v1 we must decrement v1 quota units and attribute cost correctly.

jia.chen: agree. Also UX in Console: surface an event stream when a customer experiences fallback (route_used=v1, fallback_reason=latency/quota/error). we should show recent samples and a link to the probe logs.

mike.p: curious about detection rules. do we want a simple latency threshold or a windowed detector? e.g. single spike vs sustained degradation.

alex.hunt: prefer windowed to avoid flip-flop. proposal: if p95(v2_latency) > 200ms for 60s OR error_rate(v2) > 5% for 2m OR v2_quota_available < 5% then mark degraded => switch route for new requests. fallback should be sticky for a short cool-down (5m) per-customer.

samir.rai: that sounds reasonable. also add a max-fallback-rate cap so we don't route 100% to v1 if v1 capacity is low. maybe profile-based: fallback_percentage = min(50, computed_load) initial cap 30%.

jia.chen: Console bits: add a small badge next to model selector: "soft-fallback ON" with hover showing last 10 events. And a timeline that clearly shows primary vs actual route percentages. Need a telemetry key: route.fallback.v2_to_v1 and tags: customer_id, route_pct, fallback_reason, probe_window.

mike.p: for telemetry payload shape I'd suggest fields: route_used, primary_candidate, fallback_reason, rule_trigger, sample_p95_ms, sample_error_rate, customer_tier. example: 
```
{
  "route_used": "v1",
  "primary_candidate": "v2",
  "fallback_reason": "p95_latency",
  "rule_trigger": "p95>200ms:60s",
  "sample_p95_ms": 218,
  "sample_error_rate": 1.2,
  "customer_id": "acct_1234"
}
```

infra-bot: deploy:config-service v2.18 queued by @samir.rai — expected rollout window 03:00-03:30 UTC.

samir.rai: infra note — make sure config has two flags: soft_fallback_enabled (bool) and soft_fallback_profile (string) so we can A/B different detection heuristics.

alex.hunt: also need dashboard alerts: (1) fallback_rate > 10% sustained 5m, (2) route_mismatch_rate > 2% (app requests expecting v2 outputs but got v1). Alerts should include sample requests and a quick link to replay prompt in replay-tool.

jia.chen: on telemetry retention — keep fallback events for 90d at summary level, 7d at full detail. add sampling for high-volume customers (1% detail when >100rps).

mike.p: about quotas: if v2 quota exhausted and we fallback to v1, customers should get clear billing logs. we need to ensure billing events include which model served each token: model_served=v1|v2 with token_count.

samir.rai: agreed — add meter events with tags model_served and effective_price. Also ensure logs include decision_trace_id so we can tie telemetry -> billing -> trace.

alex.hunt: implementation plan: (1) config + rollout toggle behind feature flag, (2) implement detector in routing layer with cool-down, (3) emit telemetry keys as defined, (4) console: badge + event stream + timeline + alerting, (5) billing: include model_served in usage events. can we try a controlled test on 5 internal orgs first?

jia.chen: yes — onboarding for 5 internal orgs sounds good. I'll wire the UI stubs.

mike.p: I'll implement detector and the telemetry payload. Samir can land config + rollout. Alex can own rollout plan and alerts.

samir.rai: tagging owners. I'll schedule the deploy after config-service roll. plan to enable soft_fallback=false by default, flip on for test orgs, gather telemetry for 48h.

alex.hunt: perfect. can we also add an opt-in console checkbox "show fallback events" for test orgs so SRE/support can triage quickly?

jia.chen: yep. adding that to the UI task.

mike.p: one more thing — let's include a metric "fallback_latency_delta_ms" = sample_p95_v2 - sample_p95_v1 when fallback occurs, to help evaluate quality regression.

samir.rai: good call. ok i'll add the metric and retention policy.

alex.hunt: thanks all. I'll create the PR for rollout plan + runbook. ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
